item.title: COLLEGE BASKETBALL: Prociak seals Misericordia’s OT win
item.description: Arvel Chandler kept Misericordia alive at the end of the second half. Matthew Prociak won it in overtime. Chandler hit a 3-pointer off a Darryl Wright assist with seven seconds left in regulation to force overtime. There, Prociak connected on two free throws with two seconds remaining as Misericordia escaped with a 90-88 win over King’s on Wednesday night in MAC Freedom men’s basketball play at the Anderson Center. item.title: HS SWIMMING: Hazleton Area picks up another league win
item.description: The Hazleton Area girls swimmers took another step toward an undefeated season in the Wyoming Valley Conference. Two Cougars won multiple events as Hazleton remained perfect in WVC meets with a 118-39 win over Wyoming Seminary on Wednesday afternoon. Hazleton can close out the perfect year Friday against Wilkes-Barre Area. Lia Ochs and Kathleen Rodgers each won twice for the Cougars. item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Dougherty’s strong second half leads Comets to win
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — When the offense isn’t clicking, Crestwood can always rely on the fallback plan. Play solid defense, run their offensive sets and eventually see that good things will happen. That was certainly the case for the Comets on Wednesday night in the opening round of the Wyoming Valley Conference Tournament. item.description: WILKES-BARRE — For the first two quarters, Holy Redeemer was right there with Hazleton Area, matching the Cougars shot for shot, forcing turnovers, getting out in transition and crashing the boards. item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: WVC Tournament preview
item.description: Crestwood (15-7) vs. Wyoming Area (20-2) When: Thursday, 6 p.m. Where: Wilkes-Barre Area High School Admission: Cost is $8 for adults and $4 for students and people 65 years of age and older. The only pass that will be accepted is the PIAA gold pass. Up next: The winners advance to Saturday afternoon’s championship game to play either Holy Redeemer or Dallas at 1 at Hazleton Area High School. Scouting Crestwood: The Comets earned the No. 2 seed out of Division 1 after finishing in second place.

item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: Feb. 12, 2026
item.description: Luzerne County Singing Valentines by the Wyoming Valley Barbershop Harmony Quartets: Delivery Friday, Feb. 13, and Saturday, Feb. 14. Singing Valentines include three songs, chocolates, a rose, and a card, $100. To order, please call 570-285-4810 and leave a message; calls will be returned promptly. The chorus is open to area men and women who enjoy singing four-part a cappella harmony. For information, call 570-285-4810 and leave a message or visit https://singwb.com/index.html.
